topics.title: Warhammer Tone Pro paint launch and Contrast paints being cut
topics.what_is_driving_it: Games Workshop is launching the Warhammer Tone Pro paint range while reports say 25 Contrast pots are being discontinued, and Warhammer Community is running several Tone Pro features.
topics.relevance_note: Painters will soon ask what to buy and whether their Contrast stock is worth stockpiling, so tutorial, comparison, and first-impressions content is timely now.
topics.gap_note: The signals show heavy official coverage and rumour, but no creator video comparisons or hands-on tests of Tone Pro. A side-by-side Tone Pro vs Contrast vs Base test video could own this space.

topics.title: Where has the Necromunda RPG gone?
topics.what_is_driving_it: The Necromunda RPG has disappeared from GW preview material weeks after its reveal, and players are asking what happened to it.
topics.relevance_note: The question is live and the story is unresolved, so a clear explainer on what is known, what is speculation, and what to watch for would attract searches and shares now.
topics.gap_note: Coverage so far is a single long-form speculation video and a news rumour piece. A concise, well-sourced timeline explainer with clear caveats could become the go-to answer.

topics.title: How Nurgle spreads plagues through the Immaterium
topics.what_is_driving_it: A run of short-form Nurgle lore videos is pulling very high daily view velocity and heavy comment activity.
topics.relevance_note: Nurgle lore is clearly resonating with the audience right now, so follow-up shorts and a longer explainer on Nurgle's plagues fit the momentum.

topics.title: Dawn of War IV Blood Ravens trailer and the Blood Ravens and Dark Angels link
topics.what_is_driving_it: The Dawn of War IV trailer is getting strong short-form views, and the Blood Ravens are rejoining their Dark Angels brethren in the story.
topics.relevance_note: A new game trailer tied to a fan-favourite Chapter is high-velocity lore content that can be explained cinematically in a short with clear chapter history.

topics.title: Space Marine 2 Patch 15 changes and unlocking the Victrix Guard shield
topics.what_is_driving_it: Patch 15 has landed with major changes, new heroic weapons, and a new shield unlock, driving a cluster of long-form explainers.
topics.relevance_note: Players are actively asking how the patch changes their loadouts and how to unlock new gear, so a clear patch summary has immediate search demand.

topics.title: Magnetising Adeptus Custodes with the new Magnet Baron kits
topics.what_is_driving_it: Magnet Baron has released magnetisation kits covering the Pallas, Telemon, Gyrfalcon, and Venatari, letting one build run every loadout.
topics.relevance_note: Custodes players face weapon-swap and magnetising questions as the kits land, and a step-by-step guide has clear practical demand.
topics.gap_note: Magnetising guides are usually short product mentions. A detailed build walkthrough showing magnet placement and pinning on Custodes kits would be a strong, underserved format.

topics.title: Painted Ork team showcase: The Waaagh Team
topics.what_is_driving_it: A Hobby Workshop short showcasing a customer-painted Ork team is pulling strong velocity and high engagement.
topics.relevance_note: Ork painting and army showcases are proven formats for this audience, and the video shows hobbyists want finished 40k work over generic craft clips.
topics.gap_note: Miniature painting search results are flooded with dollhouse and clay craft shorts. Painted 40k army showcases in short form are underrepresented, leaving room for a clear 40k-focused painting series.

topics.title: Four years building a Death Korps of Krieg cosplay
topics.what_is_driving_it: A creator's four-year Krieg Warhammer 40K cosplay build is gaining traction, while broader cosplay build content is booming.
topics.relevance_note: Cosplay build content is one of the strongest formats right now, and 40K-specific builds are a natural fit for this audience.
topics.gap_note: Cosplay build videos are dominated by Marvel, Disney, and Halloween content. Full 40K armour and costume builds have very little coverage, creating space for an owned build series.

topics.title: Dark Angels 5-0 BCB 40k Championship GT army list breakdown
topics.what_is_driving_it: Benjamin Frederiksen's undefeated Dark Angels list beat Orks and Thousand Sons head-to-head at the BCB 40k GT, and the lists are now being published.
topics.relevance_note: Tournament-winning lists generate immediate interest in how they work and whether they are worth copying, especially in the current meta.
topics.gap_note: Tournament list results are usually shared as text or article posts. A video breakdown explaining why the list works, with matchup clips, would be a valuable owned format.
